why: Two simulated runs appended to the archival immune log before the simulated runner isolated its own log via CDSFL_SHADOW_LOG_DIR (closed 2026-08-31). The archive is append-only and is never edited, so the separation is declared here instead. These windows are CLOSED: no simulated run can append to this file again.
method: Each line carries a timestamp (52,162 of 52,162) and each run directory carries its own start time, so every line is attributed to the run that was executing when it was written. Validated against the 8,502 lines whose runs also record their own start and end times in a report: 8,502 agreements, 0 disagreements.
